Great meeting today. I am happy to organize a demo of Encord with you both
and Chris later this week. Just let me know when is best for you all.

Labels are versioned, schema is tracked, and data is grouped into flexible
projects which you can reuse and combine. This allows you to fix labels and
not images itself, test on different slices, and tweak on schemas without
rebuilding the dataset.

In the UI selected tasks or the whole project you can export via JSON or
COCO formats. We also have an SDK for more flexible exports/automation you
want to setup. See docs here
